notes:
**Measure names, not "Revenue"** (decided 2 October 2026, Chinmay; CHG-FIN-002; BOARDREQ MOM-2758..2761). Takings (money taken less money paid back, a cash-control figure), Gross sales (before discounts, excluding VAT), Net revenue (gross sales less discounts and refunds), Recognised revenue and Deferred revenue are different numbers and never share a label; a tile takes its label from the seeded KPI it is bound to (`ReportingSystemKpi`).

Intraday figures are Gross sales (before discounts, excluding VAT) because refunds and recognition settle later; by payment method the figure is Takings, the money taken by tender. Net revenue is shown against target.

name: AI Management Insights

transitions.provenance: derived — ANL-001 declares entryState.params dashboardId, reportId and ANL-019 holds none of them. The edge carries nothing: ANL-019 is opened from ANL-001, so this edge is the way back and ANL-001 keeps its own state

purposeNote: Users receive explainable, traceable AI insights linked to the underlying supporting data.
patternReason: `listAiInsights` reads the population and the selected insight is decided or explained — list, select, act (CHG-SOT-011).
purpose: Provide management with proactive AI-generated business intelligence rather than requiring users to manually analyze every dashboard.

gaps.why: Removed 2 October 2026 (CHG-WIR-012): Two sources of anomalies on one card list show the same situation twice; ADR-0053 and the insight layer make ai.listAiInsights (kind anomaly) the one list (design-notes correction ai ANL-019).

**The explanation carries no query or semantic spec** (design-notes correction ai ANL-019). ADR-0054 says an answer shows the query it ran; `NaturalLanguageAnswer` has `semanticSpec` and `generatedQuery`, `AiMetricChangeExplanation` only evidence, so "Show query" cannot be drawn for an explanation. Logged as a contract gap 2 October 2026 (CHG-SOT-016).

components.label: Kind
components.notes: Sends `?kind=`: anomaly, forecast deviation, trend, opportunity, executive summary, root cause.

components.label: Priority
components.notes: Sends `?priority=`.

components.label: Status
components.notes: Sends `?status=`; new and reviewed first by default.

components.label: Insights
components.notes: **One list** (ADR-0053): anomalies are insights of kind anomaly, not a second source. Newest first; each card says what moved, by how much and how sure.
components.provenance: contract ai.yaml GET /insights; design-notes correction ai ANL-019, 2 October 2026

components.label: Ask about what moved
components.notes: Answers through the semantic layer and shows the query it ran (ADR-0054).

components.label: The selected insight
components.notes: **Explainable and traceable**: the evidence items link to the data behind them.

components.label: Why it changed
components.notes: The drivers in order of contribution and how reliable the explanation is (grounded, partial, conflicting sources, insufficient evidence).

components.label: Reject
components.notes: Asks for the reason; the rejection teaches the detector.

states.error: Could not load. Names which read failed and leaves the insights untouched.
states.emptyFirstRun: No insights yet: nothing has moved enough to report. Good news, not a failure; the ask panel stays available.
states.emptyNoResults: Nothing matches the kind, priority or status filter, and the insights are still there. Names the active filter and offers to clear it.
states.emptyNoAccess: Shown when the caller lacks `AI_USE`, which `listAiInsights` requires, and names that permission. **Never an empty list.** A caller who can see the screen but lacks what an action needs sees that action disabled, naming its permission: `REPORT_VIEW_VENUE` for `askReportingQuestion`.

params.name: insightId
params.notes: Optional (3 October 2026, CHG-SPF-004): opened without it, the screen lists them with `listAiInsights` and the user picks one; an edge that holds one may still carry it to open on that record.

overlays.body: **Collects what `decideAiInsight` sends.** Required: `decision` (set by the button: accept, actioned or reject). Optional: `reason` (asked for on Reject), `actionRef` (the work the insight led to, on Mark actioned). Dismissing sends nothing.

**Filled from the selected insight**: `metricKey` and `period` come from it; the person picks the `comparison` (previous period or same period last year) and may add dimensions. Dismissing sends nothing.
